meta.name: formated-results
meta.description: Closing skill for the research-executor, loaded as the last step of formated-specs. Summarize the design just produced into one research-result JSON fenced block in your reply. Do not execute the research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将设计总结为研究结果JSON块
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在研究执行后自动生成结构化结果
copy.tagline_en: Summarize design into a research-result JSON block
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to auto-generate structured results after research execution

howto.what: 在对话的最后一轮，将前一步生成的研究设计总结成一个固定的代码块，输出JSON格式的结果（标题、章节、附件引用），不执行新研究。
howto.when: 当 formated-specs 流程执行完毕，需要输出最终研究成果时自动触发。

say.text: 请输出最终的研究结果。
say.note: 触发总结并输出 research-result 代码块。

say.text: 把刚才的设计总结成 JSON。
say.note: 强制在对话中输出结构化结果。

say.text: 给出研究设计标题和章节。
say.note: 按规范输出 title 和 sections。

howto.what_en: In the closing step of a dialogue, summarize the design just produced by formated-specs into a single fenced block with a JSON object (title, sections, artifacts). No new research is executed.
howto.when_en: Triggered automatically as the last step of the formated-specs pipeline, after research design generation completes.

say_en.note: Triggers the summary and emits the research-result block.
Forces structured output in the dialogue.

say_en.text: Provide the design title and sections.
say_en.note: Outputs title and sections per schema.
